common.signInAgain: Sync ke liye phir se sign in karo

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Apna email daalo. Hum sign-in link aur 6-digit code bhejenge.
auth.checkEmailBody: Email mein link pe tap karo, ya 6-digit code yahan daalo.
auth.invalidCode: Ye code nahi chala. Dekh ke phir try karo.
auth.callbackFailed: Ye sign-in link nahi chala. Sign-in page se phir try karo.
auth.needOnline: Sign in ke liye internet chahiye.

onboarding.title: Aapko kya bulaayein?
onboarding.name: Aapka naam
onboarding.age: Main 18+ hoon aur isse sirf jaan-pehchaan waalon ke saath score rakhunga.

cards.c1b: Top-up, short aur repay, sab do-teen tap mein. Ab "11 baje lauta diya tha" waali behes nahi.
cards.c2b: Live link share karo. Har entry pe likha hai kisne aur kab daali.
cards.c3t: Raat ke end mein hisaab clear
cards.c3b: Chips gino, dekho barabar hai ya nahi, aur kisko kitna dena hai, sab ek hi screen pe.

home.quickStartHint: Aaj ki date waale naye group ke saath abhi shuru karo
home.emptyBody: Game shuru karo aur khelne waalon ko add karo. Group agli baar ke liye save rehta hai.

wizard.title: Naya game
wizard.dragHint: Seat order ke liye drag karo
wizard.kittyHint: Khaane ya host ke liye fixed contribution. Chips ke hisaab se alag.
wizard.chipCounterHint: End mein chips color se gino

live.noShorts: Abhi kisi ka short nahi hai.
live.endGameBody: Chips ginte waqt live actions lock rahenge. Game pe wapas ja sakte ho.
live.locked: Locked. Kholne ke liye dabaye rakho.
live.topUpBody: {name} bank ko {amount} cash dega aur {amount} ke chips lega.
live.readOnly: Aap ye game dekh rahe ho. Sirf host entry kar sakta hai.
live.rejectedTitle: Ab aap host nahi ho. {count, plural, one {Ye entry save nahi hui} other {Ye # entries save nahi hui}}:
live.rejectedHint: Naye host se inhe phir se daalne ko bolo.
live.nobodyToAdd: Group ke sab log table pe hain. Kisi naye ko add karo.
live.lastPlayer: Sirf ek player bachega. Game hi khatam karein?

leave.title: {name} ja raha hai
leave.deferred: {amount} raat ke end ke hisaab mein jayega.
leave.bankShort: Bank mein sirf {bank} hain. Abhi {bank} aur end mein {rest}?
leave.bankHolderBlocked: Bank {name} ke paas hai. Pehle bank kisi aur ko do.
leave.hostBlocked: Aap host ho. Pehle hosting kisi aur ko do, ya game khatam karo.

bank.shouldHold: Bank mein {amount} hone chahiye. Gin lein?
bank.handoverExpected: Bank mein {amount} hone chahiye. Cash gin ke asli amount daalo.

host.scanHint: Logged in rehte hue ye link kholenge to host ban jayenge.
host.noLoggedIn: Is game mein abhi kisi aur ka account nahi hai. QR use karo.
host.needSync: {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} sync ho rahi hai…
host.needOnline: Hosting dene ke liye internet chahiye. Connect karke phir try karo.
host.takeOverBody: Host {minutes} min se chup hai. Group admin hone ke naate aap le sakte ho.
host.takeOverWait: Host {minutes} min pehle active tha. 10 minute chup rehne ke baad le sakte ho.
host.acceptBody: Ab se saari entries aap karoge. Purana phone sirf dekh payega.
host.offline: Host offline hai. {minutes} min se koi update nahi.

combined.title: Host + bank dono chhod rahe ho

count.title: Final ginti
count.backToGameBody: Table phir se khul jayegi taaki aap record kar sako. Ab tak ki counting hat jayegi, end mein dobara count karna hoga.
count.left: {count, plural, one {# player} other {# players}} ki ginti baaki
count.missingCauses: Shayad: chips mein repay ya jaldi leave likha nahi, chips andar rakh diye, ya galat gina.
count.extraCauses: Shayad: koi short ya top-up likha nahi, kisi ke apne chips mil gaye, ya galat gina.

settle.title: Results
settle.skip: Skip karne ke liye tap karo
settle.nothing: Kisi ka kuch baaki nahi. Hisaab barabar.
settle.closeOutbox: Band karne se pehle {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} sync ho rahi hai…
settle.bankMismatch: Bank dete waqt {amount} ka farak tha

share.title: Live link share karo
share.body: Is link se koi bhi table aur poora log dekh sakta hai. Login ki zaroorat nahi.
share.needSync: Game sync hone ke baad link chalega.

e.PLAYER_LEFT: {name} {chips} ke chips ke saath gaya · {amount} ka hisaab hua
e.BANK_TRANSFERRED: Bank {name} ko diya · {expected} mein se {counted} gine
e.KITTY_MARKED: {name} ki kitty {paid, select, true {mil gayi} other {baaki}}

group.inviteBody: Is link se koi bhi group join kar sakta hai ya apna naam claim kar sakta hai. 7 din chalega.
group.archiveConfirm: {name} ko hatana hai? Dobara tap karo
group.name: Group ka naam
group.chipSetHint: Chip counter ke liye chips ke color aur value
group.noStats: Leaderboard dekhne ke liye ek game band karo.
group.onlyAdmins: Ye sirf admins badal sakte hain.
group.noGroups: Abhi koi group nahi. Game shuru karo to ban jayega.

history.title: History
history.claimHint: Stats dekhne ke liye kisi group mein apna naam claim karo.
history.chartLabel: {count, plural, one {# game} other {# games}} mein net {net}

me.title: Main
me.deleteBody: Isse aapki profile hat jayegi aur har group mein aapka naam account se alag ho jayega. Group history mein nickname rahega. Ye wapas nahi hoga.
me.deleteConfirm: Confirm karne ke liye DELETE likho
me.signOutUnsynced: {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} abhi sync nahi hui. Sign out karne par ye is phone se hat jayengi.
me.iosInstallBody: Share dabao, phir "Add to Home Screen".

viewer.notSynced: Ye game abhi sync nahi hua. Host online aate hi dikhega.
viewer.expired: Ye link expire ho gaya ya band kar diya gaya.
viewer.thisIsMeBody: Ye game apni history mein daalne ke liye sign in karo.
viewer.claimed: Aapki history mein add ho gaya.

join.title: {group} join karo
join.body: Kya aapka naam pehle se list mein hai? Claim karo taaki history saath rahe.
join.signIn: Join karne ke liye sign in karo

landing.sub: Teen patti night pe buy-in, top-up aur shorts track karo. Ginti kahan gadbad hui, turant dikhe. Do minute mein hisaab.
landing.f1b: Har short aur repay usi waqt likha jaata hai, saath mein kisne daala aur kab.
landing.f2b: Live link share karo. Dost apne phone pe table update hote dekhein.
landing.f3b: End mein chips gino. Table mein farak ho to kitna aur kyun, turant dikhe.
landing.f4b: Kisko kitna dena hai, sabse kam transfers mein. WhatsApp pe share karo.
landing.f5b: Poori raat airplane mode mein khelo. Online aate hi sync.
landing.noMoney: Hisaab kabhi paisa nahi bhejta ya rakhta. Sirf score rakhta hai.
landing.adults: Sirf 18+ ke liye, jaan-pehchaan waalon ke saath score rakhne ko.
landing.closer: Chips tum lao. Hisaab hum rakhenge.

install.title: Hisaab install karo
install.body: Home screen pe lagao. Turant khulega, offline bhi.

offline.title: Aap offline ho
offline.body: Ek baar online rehte Hisaab kholo, uske baad bina signal ke bhi chalega.

errors.not_live: Ginti shuru ho chuki hai. Pehle game pe wapas jao.
errors.repay_exceeds: Zyada se zyada {max} lauta sakte ho
errors.void_breaks_log: Baad ki entry (#{seq}) isi pe tiki hai. Pehle use void karo.
errors.bank_holder_must_handover: Jaane se pehle bank kisi ko do
errors.stint_left: Ye player table chhod chuka hai
errors.closed: Ye raat band ho chuki hai. Pehle reopen karo.
